datasets.title: HIV - Env Closed State - Full-Length Membrane-Embedded - 5.25 µs
datasets.description: Molecular dynamics simulations of Full-length HIV-1 clade A BG505 Env trimer (gp160), three protomers, glycosylated and palmitoylated, embedded in an asymmetric lipid bilayer mimicking the composition of the viral budding site. Ectodomain HXB2 residues 31-662, with the SOSIP mutations and the furin cleavage site reverted to the native clade A sequence (UniProt Q2N0S6); MPER, transmembrane domain and cytoplasmic tail included; the two cytoplasmic-tail cysteines C764 and C837 palmitoylated. (256,522 atoms). Starting structure: Composite model. Ectodomain built on the BG505 SOSIP.664 crystal structure (PDB 5T3Z, 3.5 A), with the missing gaps modelled as disordered loops in Modeller 10.3. MPER-TMD-CT built by i-TASSER homology modelling on the clade D NMR structure PDB 7LOI, carrying the clade A sequence. The two halves were joined through the HR2 helix (residues 637-668) re-modelled with AlphaFold2, and the junction relaxed with autoIMD in VMD. The finished MPER was checked against the crystal structure PDB 4G6F.. Glycan profile: Heterogeneous, site-specific profile derived from glycoanalytic data for clade A BG505 viral Env: 23 N-linked sites glycosylated per monomer, not uniform across protomers. N185e, N185h, N618 and N625 are left unoccupied, as they have no consistent evidence of occupancy in clade A BG505. Glycans were built with Glycan Reader & Modeler in CHARMM-GUI, preserving the GlcNAc / GlcNAc2 / ManGlcNAc2 cores resolved in the cryo-EM structures as a scaffold where feasible. Per-chain detail: Supplementary Tables 1-3 of the related publication.. Setup: TIP3P water, 150 mM NaCl. Sampling: 5 × 1050 ns, one frame every 100 ps. Related publication: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-71874-2. This entry is metadata only. Trajectories stored on lab storage; available on request. Contact: maalbani@ucsd.edu.
